free_tier.stated: Pay as you go at USD 0.00 with welcome credit included and no card required; USD 20 of welcome credit is given on signup, USD 8 after email verification and the remaining USD 12 after the first day.
free_tier.notes: A separate browser trial at /try gives one five-minute sandbox with no account, network limited to package registries.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a sandbox, not a stored object

retention.stated: An idle sandbox sleeps and keeps its files; a pay-as-you-go sleeping sandbox is kept 7 days, extendable to 14 days, and disk above the plan allowance is charged every 8 hours.
retention.notes: The 14-day extension is the plan's maximum, not its default.

egress.terms: The default network mode is full public internet access; private networks, provider infrastructure and outgoing SMTP are always blocked, and inbound connections are blocked. No per-GB egress price is published; disk above the included allowance is USD 0.06 per GB-month.
egress.free_allowance: unmetered outbound traffic at the default network mode

interface_detail: MCP, Python SDK, TypeScript SDK and REST API; a browser terminal is available for the no-signup trial.
tooling: pip install wbxsandbox or npm install wbxsandbox; a REST API, MCP connector and wbx interactive shell; background jobs, batches, budgets and signed receipts.
chaining: An agent reaches the sandbox through MCP or the SDK, runs untrusted code there and pulls back result files and signed job receipts.

limits.value: 10 vCPU and 10 GB RAM in total across sandboxes
6 hours per sandbox, then 7 days asleep extendable to 14 days

limits_note: Usage is billed per second at USD 0.038 per vCPU-hour and USD 0.013 per GB RAM-hour multiplied by the compute class price; the Economy class is 1x.
binding_note: The 10 vCPU and 10 GB total allocation and the 10-sandbox concurrency cap bind before credit runs out on the smallest workloads.

identity_cost.detail: The signup form asks for a name, an email address and a password of at least 10 characters; Google and GitHub signup are also offered. Email verification releases the first USD 8 of credit and the first day releases the rest. No card is required; billing details (country, company) are asked only when the user pays.

reliability_note: The sandboxes are Firecracker microVMs in Europe; sleeping sandboxes are deleted after the plan's retention period, and the browser trial is deleted after five minutes.
confidence_note: Rates, caps, retention, egress restrictions and the signup fields are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-24.
